title: Bottom plate
note: Holds the four hip servos, the deck pillars and the battery straps.

title: Deck
note: Top plate: bushings for the hip pins, 20×20 flight-controller standoffs, ESP32 bay.

title: Canopy
settings: 2 walls · 10 % · tree supports under the roof
note: Shell over the electronics with hex and side vents and a USB-C slot at the front.

title: Upper leg (coxa)
settings: 4 walls · 40 % · supports for the knee frame and stop ledge
note: Bolts to the hip servo horn; its pin turns in the deck. Holds the knee servo and the end stop (magnet + M3 levelling screw).

title: Lower leg / drone arm
settings: 4 walls · 40 % · prints upside down (motor seat on the bed) · tree supports under the arm and tail
note: Leg when walking, arm when flying. Slotted motor mount fits any 1103-1404 motor (9 mm circle, 9×9, 12×12); the toe is the landing gear.

title: Foot boot
note: Slips over each toe: grip for walking, cushion for landing.

title: Horn spacer (optional)
note: Only if a servo horn sits below flush in its pocket.
